text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: —Yeah, no signs of worsening here.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"However, as I mentioned before, please refrain from excessive training for a while.
Please monitor your progress carefully, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Thank you so much, Teacher!☆
It happened just as I was heading back to the academy after finishing the follow-up observation on my injury—
Ugh... *sniff*... *hic*... *sob*.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mmh! Ding-ding-ding!!
I'm feeling it... It's coming to me!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is huge!
It's coming, it's coming!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It's tingling!
—My Marvelous-Deficiency Sensor is, that is!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: The one I'm sensing is~~~... this one!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Hurry, hurry, Trainer, you too--!!
(Patter patter patter patter!!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "Spotted! A Marvelous Emergency Depletion Zone!"

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!?
Wh-Who is that!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm Marvelous Sunday☆
I'm here to bring you marvelousnessっ★

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text: I-I don't get it at all! That's creepy...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to think about what it means☆
Marvelous is something you just gotta feel★
I apologized to the terrified boy for suddenly walking in, explaining that I had simply overheard his crying.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: There are Marvelous tears in this world, but yours aren't like that, are they? What happened?

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Who cares!
It's got nothing to do with you, Onee-chan—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
There is!☆ Because after all,
you and I have already met!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Then we're practically family already, aren't we?☆
A miracle! Destiny! Marrrrvelous★

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
Ehh...?
...Haha. You really are a weird big sis.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "You smiled! Wonderful☆ I wanna see that smile more and more, so much more★"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, won't you tell me?
Why were you crying just now?

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
...I...
...I, you know—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I see. So you got injured
in that soccer practice match.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
If I performed well, I could've made the regular squad.
But I... panicked, got tangled up in my own feet...
fell over, and then...

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text: "...There was this guy who was always on the same team as me, fighting for the same position. In the end, he became the regular starter."

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
I've just been sleeping here the whole time...
...while she's been practicing every day, competing in matches, and getting better and better.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure... I'll never be able to
close the gap between us now..."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You think so?
I'm sure you'll get another chance once your injury heals!

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text: "...Ghh, how would you even know that!? You're not a doctor or a coach, Sis!"

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
Getting hurt was bad enough on its own, but then
they told me my body takes forever to heal!!
What the hell am I even supposed to do about that?!

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
I'm...!!
I'm completely finished...!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You think so? Hmm... but words aren't enough?
Hmm, hmm... If that's the case—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah!! Look at the time!! That's right, that's right!!
—Trainer, turn on the TV!!

I pick up the remote as instructed.
Then, what appears on the screen is—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: “—And now, entering the track to thunderous cheers, the number one favorite, Fuji Kiseki!!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
That star power is truly overwhelming!!
The fans, having eagerly awaited this spectacular show,
are going wild in the stands!

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text: Ah... It's Fuji Kiseki. So cool...

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
Well yeah, of course I know her... The guys at the club always talk about how crazy strong and fast she is.
...Wait, why a race all of a sudden...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆
...Now, watch closely! It's starting!!

Marvelous Sunday just laughs.
Her true intentions remain a mystery. The boy,
though pouting, reluctantly looks at the screen.
And—Fuji Kiseki's race got underway.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Nakayama Racecourse is reported to be Yielding, bordering on Soft!
What kind of strength will the highly anticipated Fuji Kiseki display?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haa—haa—haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Into the final straight, and Fuji Kiseki takes the lead early!
Fuji Kiseki is looking strong! Will she go all the way?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Across the finish line!!
Fuji Kiseki proves her strength once again,
an overwhelming victory leaving the rest in the dust!”

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
Holy... crap... Fuji Kiseki really is
insaaaanely fast...

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, no, seriously!
What's the deal with that!? I don't get it at all!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, guess what, guess what?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Fuji, you see, is in the same class year as me! ☆

The boy's eyes widen.
Then, looking surprised, he glances between the two.

Fuji Kiseki on screen, bathed in thunderous cheers.
And Marvelous Sunday right before my eyes—currently visiting the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text: Classmates... that means debuting in the same year, right?

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
...Sis, why are you here?
Why aren't you... running in races?
choice_data_list: ...I'm injured, so I still can't push myself too hard.
...I'm injured, so I still can't push myself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text: ! Then... Big Sis is gonna be ruined too—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Nope, you're not bad at all! ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I got injured☆
Can't push hard in training★
Can't enter many races either☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, that doesn't make it bad!!
I am super, totally 'Marvelous'!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Fuji's amazing, isn't she?☆
Shouldering everyone's expectations and claiming 1st place★
Everyone is super hyped up☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"I must've worked super hard for today's victory!
Running and running, and running some more!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: That is super marvelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm working hard too, ya know! ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Adjusting our pace, taking our rests!
Training a little bit every day!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Can't push too hard? But I am doing my best!
Consulting with the doctors a whole bunch,
and working with Trainer, every single day!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Fuji's efforts! My efforts!
Is one really greater than the other?
Does only one of them hold true value?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what do you think?
Who's more amazing, me or Fuji?

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
T-There's no way...
I can choose something like that...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Right, I can't choose☆
Because both are just so Marvelous★☆★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And so, you see.
My marvelous, Fuji's marvelous—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
If rivals who've made different kinds of effort
run in the same race one day... ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
What kind of marvelous is waiting there?!
Isn't your heart pounding? Aren't you excited?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Using that thrilling excitement as fuel!
Don't you think it helps you give it your all?

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text: Big sis...

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha.
Are you trying to say I'm the same way?"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: You can't change the past where you got injured, right?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "Still, the me right now gets to decide what the future me becomes☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, just ask yourself!
Ask your heart! Be honest with yourself!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Why are you so frustrated you could cry?
Is it because you're out of options? Because you want to give up?
Or is it—

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text: ...Because I want to stand back up.

text_block_list.name: Hospitalized Boy
text_block_list.text:
Because... I still believe
I've got what it takes.
—As I left the room, the young boy waved and said, "Thank you."
choice_data_list: I hope she feels better soon.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, I already noticed!
People who work hard, people who can give it their all are—"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Everyone and everything is Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer!!
I talked to that girl just now, but—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to it☆ Someday, I'm gonna have a marvelous race with Fuji★

"Marvelous Sunday laughs, saying it
with a cheerful, casual air as if it were
nothing at all."
Still—just how amazing that really is.
choice_data_list: (I really want to make her dream come true.)
(I really want to make her dream come true.)

text_block_list.text:
Reaffirming that deep, resolute determination,
I headed home on the path back.
